**Article Details for PMID: 42704524**

**Title:** The 2025 AHA/ACC Hypertension Guidelines: Key Updates, Historical Context, and Clinical Implications.

**Authors:** John M Giacona, Wanpen Vongpatanasin

**Journal:** Current cardiology reports
**Publication Date:** 2026-09-07
**DOI:** 10.1007/s11886-026-02413-0
**PMC ID:** 13550040
**Full Text Available:** Yes
**Full Text URL:** https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC13550040/


**Abstract:**
This review examines the 2025 American Heart Association/American College of Cardiology multisociety hypertension guideline, placing its recommendations in historical context and evaluating the supporting evidence across major clinical populations.
